name: DayOneLead API
description: Newly registered businesses plus a cold email engine. Browse is unlimited; contact details cost one of 200 daily credits per lead (shared with CSV export); campaigns send from your own mailbox and use no credits. Launch, reply, and end use preview-and-approve: call once without confirm to get a preview and approval_token, then again with confirm: true.
